With N8N Chat UI, you can: [...] Who is this for?

 Developers building AI agents and chatbots with n8n.
 Indie hackers and startups embedding chatbots into landing pages.
 Agencies and freelancers delivering branded AI-driven tools for clients.
 Anyone seeking a no-code/low-code way to add modern, interactive chat widgets to their site.
